assets.use: Title screen backdrop (ui/titleBackdrop.ts), animated in the DOM
assets.prompt:
Title-screen illustration for a fantasy story RPG, wide cinematic 16:9 landscape (1672x941 or similar 16:9), NIGHT scene of a peaceful rural fantasy valley. High-quality 16-bit pixel art like a modern SNES-inspired fantasy adventure RPG, crisp visible square pixels, clean dark outlines, limited palette, rich painterly pixel shading, soft natural moonless starlight. Side-on panoramic view, NOT top-down.
Composition: the upper 55% is a deep night sky in night-blue and violet with many small stars and a faint milky band; slightly left of center, in the WEST (left third), one exceptionally bright large star (Crios) with soft cross-shaped rays and a gentle TURQUOISE shimmer/halo around it (turquoise #49e0c8 only here). Below: layered rolling hills fading into blue haze in the distance; in the middle distance on a gentle hill a small half-timbered farmhouse with a thatched roof and ONE warm orange-yellow glowing window, a thin wisp of chimney smoke, a wooden fence, a big old tree beside it; a field of ripe wheat silvered by starlight. On the right side a dark forest edge with tall deciduous trees and pines. Foreground (bottom 15%): dark tall grass, wildflowers and ferns in silhouette, a few softly glowing yellow-green fireflies scattered near the grass. Calm, wistful, magical, late summer. The center of the sky is fairly empty and calm (space for a game logo).
Palette: night blue, deep violet, dark summer green, wheat gold in moonless starlight, warm orange window light, a touch of turquoise only around the star.
Absolutely NO people, no animals in focus, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no border, no UI.
Match the painted pixel-art style of the attached reference images (detailed SNES-style landscapes).

variants.note: beautiful too; the wheat field is smaller and the sky centre busier
calm sky for the logo, Crios in the west, warm window, wheat, forest edge; the walled town on the western hill reads as Trapas
